definitions.illuminate: Placed Light lasts the battle. Enemies starting a turn in Light are Exposed 2.
definitions.vision: Vision reveals every hidden enemy while active.
definitions.umbra_eclipse: Last Eclipse hits you and your illusions only on Marked tiles, then starts Eclipse for X turns.
definitions.skill_sunpath: Once per turn, when you @icon(move) or @icon(blink) 3+ tiles, leave @icon(illuminate) 1 on your path.
definitions.skill_afterglow: When an @icon(illusion) is removed, leave @icon(illuminate) 1 on the illusion's tile.
definitions.skill_open_sky: While you stand in @icon(illuminate), you have @icon(vision).

keyword:illuminate: Placed Light lasts the battle. Enemies starting a turn in Light are Exposed 2.
Reveals tiles within the Light radius through the Umbra.
keyword:vision: Vision reveals every hidden enemy while active.

grimoire_line_updates.eclipse: The darkest Umbra stage: you see only 1 tile around you. Light still reveals.
grimoire_line_updates.umbra_eclipse: Last Eclipse hits you and your illusions only on Marked tiles, then starts Eclipse for 2 turns.

relic_descriptions.pilgrim_boots: Gain 1 more @kw(movement) each turn. Moving leaves radius-1 @term(illuminate) on tiles you enter, unless the card attacks. @kw(blink) lights both ends.
relic_descriptions.static_soles: Your first @kw(move) or @kw(blink) each turn leaves @term(surface_electrified) on the starting tile and grants @term(vision) for 2 turns.
relic_descriptions.thawing_charm: Excess healing becomes @term(stoneskin), up to 8 each turn. The first conversion each turn creates radius-1 @term(illuminate) on you.
relic_descriptions.phoenix_ember: Gain 1 @term(defiance). When @kw(defiance) saves you, create @term(illuminate) 3 on your tile, place @term(surface_fire) under every enemy, @kw(draw) 3 and gain 3 @term(card_play|Card Plays).
relic_descriptions.cinderbrand_tongs: Your first card each turn to create new @icon(surface_fire) also creates @icon(illuminate) 1 at the card's target.
relic_descriptions.voltaic_tuning_fork: The first @icon(chain) attack each turn creates @icon(illuminate) {radius} beneath each enemy hit.
relic_descriptions.hollow_die: When a card grants @icon(vision), create @icon(illuminate) {0.reward0.radius} at you.
relic_descriptions.moonless_compass: Once per combat, play separate @icon(move)/@icon(blink) and @icon(illuminate)/@icon(vision) cards in one turn to gain @icon(stoneskin) {0.reward0.amount} and @icon(card_play) {0.reward1.amount}.
relic_descriptions.dawnbrand_filament: The first direct attack each turn creates @icon(illuminate) {radius} at the attack's target.
relic_descriptions.dawnstitch_cord: The first card each turn that creates @icon(illuminate) or grants @icon(vision) grants @icon(block) {0.reward0.amount}.
relic_descriptions.starless_astrolabe: While you have @icon(vision), applying @icon(stagger) with Ice or applying @icon(shock) creates @icon(illuminate) {radius} beneath that enemy.
relic_descriptions.tallow_candle: At the start of combat, create radius-2 @term(illuminate) on your tile.
